liebermann.notes: Benedictional and pontifical of the late 10th century from Newminster, Winchester, for its abbot Æthelgar (later bishop of Selsey and archbishop of Canterbury), formerly owned by Archbishop Robert of Canterbury, then Rouen Cathedral; f. 162 Consecratio regis with the Sacramentum coronationis. Cf. Rj.

entries.text_de: Rouen Bibliothèque municipale 369 (Y 7)1. Benedictional und Pontifical Ende 10. Jhs., aus Newminster bei Winchester, für dessen Abt Aethelgar, der 977 das Bisthum Selsey, 988 Canterbury erhielt, früher Erzbischof Robert von Canterbury, dann der Kathedrale Rouen gehörig. [Vgl. Rj.] F. 162 Consecratio regis mit Sacr cor, u. S. 214; vgl. o. S. xxxii3.
entries.text_en: Rouen Bibliothèque municipale 369 (Y 7)1. Benedictional and pontifical of the end of the 10th century, from Newminster near Winchester, for its abbot Aethelgar, who received the bishopric of Selsey in 977 and Canterbury in 988; formerly belonging to Archbishop Robert of Canterbury, then to the cathedral of Rouen. [Cf. Rj.] F. 162 Consecratio regis with Sacr cor, below, p. 214; cf. above, p. xxxii3.

notes.text_de: vgl. Morinus De sacris ordinat. (1695) p. 230; Gage in Archaeologia 24 (1832) p. 118; Warren Leofric missal 279; Westwood Miniatures p. 139; [Pottier] bei Frère Manuel du bibliogr. Norm. I 91: Omont Catal. des mss. des départ.: Rouen (1888); Henderson York pontifical p. xviii.
notes.text_en: cf. Morinus De sacris ordinat. (1695) p. 230; Gage in Archaeologia 24 (1832) p. 118; Warren Leofric missal 279; Westwood Miniatures p. 139; [Pottier] in Frère Manuel du bibliogr. Norm. I 91: Omont Catal. des mss. des départ.: Rouen (1888); Henderson York pontifical p. xviii.
